description: New original illustrations for the Today discovery cards, with separate subjects and palettes: amber lantern, teal waterfall, violet dream book. Supersedes the v1 crops for these cards.

assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: finished portrait background illustration for the "Daily ritual" discovery card in Noctalia, an elegant dream-journaling app. Generate one single illustration, 4:5 portrait, ideally 1024 by 1280 pixels.
Primary request: a large glowing amber lantern in a quiet terracotta stone alcove, a tangible invitation to pause and begin a small evening ritual.
Scene/backdrop: close intimate architectural space, softly textured burnt-sienna plaster arch, just a suggestion of a leafy shadow. The lantern hangs centrally in the upper half; it is the unmistakable dominant subject, shown large enough to read at a 148px-wide thumbnail.
Style/medium: exquisite atmospheric digital oil painting with visible fine brushwork, subtle magical realism, restrained editorial illustration, rich luminous materials, refined and calm.
Color palette: warm copper, terracotta, deep umber and honey amber; warm image throughout.
Composition/framing: vertical close-up, lantern and its warm pool of light between 12% and 54% of image height, sculptural arch framing it. Lower 38% is quiet dark umber plaster and shadow for a separate white title overlay supplied by the app.
Constraints: edge-to-edge full-bleed art, opaque background; no text, no letters, no lettering, no logo, no border, no collage, no people, no mountains, no broad landscape, no sunset sky, no lake. The illustration must feel visually different from a blue-green waterfall and a violet open-book scene.

Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: finished portrait background illustration for the "Evening soundscapes" discovery card in Noctalia, an elegant dream-journaling app. Generate one single illustration, 4:5 portrait, ideally 1024 by 1280 pixels.
Primary request: a silky small waterfall descending between dark mossy rocks into a serene turquoise forest pool at night, capturing the soothing sound of water.
Scene/backdrop: intimate nocturnal woodland grotto, ferns and soft moss at the edges. A broad silver-teal ribbon of falling water forms a gentle diagonal from the upper right toward the center-left. Soft luminous mist just above the pool, delicate reflected glints.
Style/medium: exquisite atmospheric digital oil painting with visible fine brushwork, subtle magical realism, restrained editorial illustration, refined and calm. Avoid photographic hyperrealism.
Color palette: unmistakably cool deep teal, petrol blue, emerald and pale turquoise; no warm amber sky.
Composition/framing: vertical view, bold readable cascade occupying upper 55%, close enough to be recognized at a 148px-wide thumbnail. Lower 38% is a smooth very dark teal pool for a separate white title overlay supplied by the app.
Constraints: edge-to-edge full-bleed art, opaque background; no text, no letters, no logo, no border, no collage, no people, no lantern, no books, no mountains, no sunrise or sunset clouds, no broad sky. This image must be immediately different in subject, silhouette and palette from a warm terracotta lantern and a violet open-book scene.

Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: finished portrait background illustration for the "Dream guides" discovery card in Noctalia, an elegant dream-journaling app. Generate one single illustration, 4:5 portrait, ideally 1024 by 1280 pixels.
Primary request: a large open ivory dream book, seen in graceful three-quarter view, with a few delicate luminous constellation lines and pearl-like stars rising from its pages into a soft violet night.
Scene/backdrop: mysterious but welcoming plum and lilac darkness. The open book floats lightly, tactile cream pages gently curved, page edges touched by lavender light. No readable writing; the pages are mostly blank with only delicate abstract celestial marks.
Style/medium: exquisite atmospheric digital oil painting with visible fine brushwork, subtle magical realism, restrained editorial illustration, refined and calm.
Color palette: violet, dusty lilac, rich aubergine, warm ivory pages, soft silver glimmers. The bright open book silhouette is unmistakable even at a 148px-wide thumbnail.
Composition/framing: vertical close-up, the open book fills 75% of the image width around 35-55% of image height, a restrained arc of stars above it. Lower 38% fades naturally into quiet deep aubergine for a separate white title overlay supplied by the app.
Constraints: edge-to-edge full-bleed art, opaque background; no text, no letters, no words, no logo, no border, no collage, no people, no horizon landscape, no mountains, no sunset sky, no lantern, no waterfall. Distinct object-based composition rather than another landscape.
